result.description:
Farnese Australia Pty Ltd. is seeking a full Time Service Technician to join our team based in Ingleburn NSW.

Reporting to the Services Manager, this is a hands-on, permanent role where you will play a key part in machine installations, preventive and breakdown maintenance. You will work across mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, and hydraulic systems, servicing machinery such as CNC Machine Centres, Bridge Saws, Block Saws, and Jib / Gantry Cranes.
This role offers variety and the opportunity to work both autonomously and within a team. While qualifications are not essential, any mechanical or electrical aptitude will be highly regarded.

Key Responsibilities:
•	Perform preventive and breakdown maintenance of machinery.
•	Install, modify, maintain and repair complex and highly sophisticated electronic instruments and control systems which involve a combination of electrical, electronic and hydraulic and pneumatic principals.
•	Install and service equipment, including mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, and hydraulic components.
•	Interpret electrical drawings and perform diagnostic checks.
•	Liaise with clients to understand and address service requirements.

What We Offer:
•	A permanent, full-time role in a supportive team environment.
•	A company vehicle for both work and personal use.
•	Opportunity for hands-on, technical work with diverse, cutting edge equipment.

Essential Criteria
•	Ability to interpret electrical and mechanical concepts and drawings.
•	Ability to install, modify, maintain and repair complex and highly sophisticated electronic instruments and control systems which involve a combination of electrical, electronic and hydraulic and pneumatic principals.
•	Previous experience in machinery preventive maintenance.
•	Strong mechanical aptitude and fault-finding skills.
•	Excellent communication and client liaison skills.
•	Reliable work ethic with attention to detail and accuracy.
•	Ability to work independently or as part of a team.
•	Current driver's licence.
•	Minimum of less than 1 year of machinery preventive maintenance experience required.
•	Ability to interpret basic electrical symbols and drawings required.

Desirable Criteria:
•	Electrical fault-finding experience.
•	Knowledge of electrical control systems.
•	Experience with CNC machine technology and operation.
•	Background in the stone industry, manufacturing, or machinery service.

Renumeration: $85,000 - $105,000 + Super for the right candidate.

If you are looking for a hands-on, technically challenging role with the potential to grow and expand your skill set, we'd love to hear from you. Apply now and become an integral part of our team at Farnese Australia.

result.description: Talent Plus Pty Ltd  About the Role Developer Programmer (Solar Installation Firm) | KI INVESTMENT GROUP  | SA Energy - Solar & Battery   KI Investment Group is seeking a skilled Quality Assurance Engineer to drive digital transformation across our solar installation operations. This role focuses on building integrated systems that streamline workflows, improve efficiency, and enable real-time data flow across departments including sales, design, installation, procurement, and maintenance.  You will play a key role in Quality Assurance Engineer, automating processes, enhancing system performance, and supporting scalable growth in a fast-paced renewable energy environment.   Benefits  This is a role where Employee would have opportunity to work on latest systems.   Competitive salary  Flexible work hours  Opportunities for career growth and development    Task & responsibilities  Job Tasks – Solar Industry Role   Scheduling, coordinating, and conducting quality assurance inspections of solar PV installations, electrical systems, equipment, and project documentation to ensure compliance with Australian Standards, manufacturer requirements, and company procedures.  Reviewing and analysing solar installation data, system performance reports, technical documentation, commissioning records, and compliance certificates to identify quality issues, performance gaps, and improvement opportunities.  Identifying installation variations, technical risks, safety concerns, and potential non-compliance areas relating to solar PV systems, electrical works, equipment configuration, and operational procedures.  Developing and recommending corrective action plans to resolve quality issues, improve installation processes, enhance system reliability, and ensure compliance with industry standards and regulatory requirements.  Communicating, educating, and liaising with installers, electricians, engineers, project managers, customers, and management teams to promote awareness and adherence to quality standards, safety procedures, and best practices.  Assisting with troubleshooting, diagnosing, testing, and resolving technical issues associated with solar PV systems, inverters, battery storage systems, monitoring platforms, electrical components, and installation processes.  Providing technical guidance, training, and support to solar installation teams regarding system design, installation procedures, commissioning requirements, software applications, and operational practices.  Analysing, evaluating, and diagnosing technical faults related to solar equipment, including photovoltaic panels, inverters, battery energy storage systems, monitoring software, communication devices, electrical components, and control systems.  Conducting system testing, performance assessments, and fault diagnosis activities to identify installation defects, equipment failures, configuration issues, and operational inefficiencies while ensuring compliance with established testing procedures.  Reviewing solar system designs, installation methodologies, and technical architectures to assess current performance, identify future improvement opportunities, and recommend suitable technology upgrades and solutions.  Preparing, maintaining, and reviewing technical documentation including inspection reports, quality audit records, compliance documents, installation procedures, troubleshooting guides, maintenance manuals, and technical specifications.  Maintaining accurate records of solar project audits, corrective actions, equipment testing results, maintenance activities, and quality improvement initiatives.  Supporting continuous improvement initiatives by analysing recurring technical issues, identifying root causes, and implementing strategies to improve solar installation quality, safety, and customer satisfaction.  Ensuring all solar projects comply with relevant Australian regulations and standards, including electrical safety requirements, Clean Energy Council guidelines, manufacturer specifications, and workplace health and safety procedures.   This is a full-time permanent role, with at least 38hrs/week engagement.    Qualification & experience  • Bachelor’s degree in Quality Management, Engineering or relevant field,  • Proven experience as a Quality Assurance Manager would be preferred,  • Strong understanding of energy sector, processes, methods, materials, and quality requirements.  • Experience managing quality systems, audits, and compliance processes.   Skills and Abilities:   • Strong leadership skills with the ability to guide and influence teams.  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality outcomes.  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a project environment.
